author: JackBOTW
quote: It’s not my kind of game. I always saw it as a social craze. I played it because of pressure from people around me. It’s a good game—that’s all. Whatever it gains by dazzling you with its graphics, it loses through poor gameplay. This is a game for kids who follow trends.

author: JackBOTW
quote: A beautiful game. I didn’t have the chance to play the 1998 version. I’ve always heard positive things about it; I can see why—this is a game that leaves an indelible mark. Wonderful.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
